name: Telegram
description: Telegram offers free Bot API, Telegram API (MTProto), TDLib and a paid Gateway API for developers.
auth_notes: Telegram API uses api_id and api_hash obtained at my.telegram.org plus phone-based user authorization; Bot API bots are created via @botfather. Gateway API credential format not shown.
gate_detail: Sign up for Telegram, log in at my.telegram.org and fill the API development tools form to get api_id and api_hash. One api_id per phone number. Gateway API is free to test, charged per delivered message.
api_scope: Bot API for message-based programs, Telegram API and TDLib for custom clients, and a Gateway API that sends verification codes via Telegram instead of SMS.
mcp_notes: Only a third-party MTProto MCP project appears in the sources; no Telegram-published MCP server is shown.
blocker_detail: No approval or payment needed for the Bot or Telegram API; accounts using unofficial clients are monitored and abuse leads to bans. Gateway messages are charged.

evidence.quote: Go to "API development tools" and fill out the form.
You will get basic addresses as well as the api_id and api_hash parameters required for user authorization.
You are welcome to use both APIs free of charge.
The Bot API allows you to easily create programs that use Telegram messages for an interface.
The Bot API can't read history. MTProto can.

issues: REST style is not explicitly labeled for the Bot API in the sources.
Bot API token mechanics are not described beyond a @botfather mention.
S6 is a third-party MCP project, so MCP is community only.
Sandbox only implied by a testing-only sample api_id and free Gateway testing.
